what_it_does: This paper targets robotic perception tasks like simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM, which builds maps while tracking the robot's position) and structure-from-motion (reconstructing 3D scenes from images). These tasks involve diverse computational operations (point cloud registration, pose graph optimization, bundle adjustment, feature matching) whose demand constantly changes with the environment and task, making it impossible to dedicate specialized hardware to each operation. The paper proposes an FPGA-based accelerator with a flexible array of processing units that can be dynamically reconfigured at runtime by analyzing which operations are currently running and scheduling them efficiently.
